articles.title: ISRO images, drone captures expose 1 lakh trees felled in Chhattisgarh tiger reserve's core area
articles.summary: ISRO satellite imagery combined with drone surveillance has exposed the illegal felling of approximately 1 lakh trees within the core area of a tiger reserve in Chhattisgarh. This significant environmental damage, impacting a critical wildlife habitat, was brought to light through advanced monitoring technologies, raising serious concerns about deforestation and wildlife conservation efforts within the state.

articles.summary: Veselov and Angulo de Lafuente propose a novel framework for investigating artificial consciousness. articles.title: Show HN: Porting Open3D to Python without writing a LoC
articles.summary: This article explores an efficient method for integrating C++ computed point clouds directly into Python applications. It details a simplified binding approach, exemplified by `bind_class<PointCloud>`, which eliminates the need for typical boilerplate like `.def()` functions or trampoline classes. This streamlined process enables seamless leverage of C++'s computational power within Python's versatile environment for complex data processing and visualization tasks.

articles.title: How will Atlético Madrid line up against Athletic Bilbao in LaLiga?
